speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I will be your doctor today; to understand the cause of your acute diarrhea, please tell me when your symptoms started and if you have had any fever or blood in your stool.

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI). This patient presents with acute, frequent watery diarrhea and cramping shortly after receiving levofloxacin, a known risk factor for CDI. I am proceeding with a stool test to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: C.diff_toxin_assay.
